Mohd Rizwan vs Eng 2022

G Phillips vs Ind 2026
Arshdeep Singh to Glenn Phillips, 1 run, 15 off the over. Full ball just outside off, Phillips drives to Ishan Kishan at sweeper cover and retains strike
Bhuvneshwar Kumar [3.0-0-31-0] is back into the attack

Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Glenn Phillips, 2 runs, the record of most runs in a bilateral T20I series now belongs to Glenn Phillips - 332 and counting. He fetches the short ball from outside off and drags the pull to the right of deep square. A fumble from Abhishek enables a second run

Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Glenn Phillips, no run, full toss well wide of off at 122ks. Would have been a wide had Phillips left that alone, not to be. He throws his hands and slices it to the left of short third
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Glenn Phillips, no run, slower ball bumper at 117ks, Phillips looks to flay it over the keeper and gets beaten due to lack of pace and extra bounce
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Glenn Phillips, no run, 125ks yorker on the stumps, Phillips squeezes it back to the right of the bowler
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Glenn Phillips, FOUR, scores level. Full ball veering down leg, Phillips helps it away to the fine leg fence with a neat clip of the pads

Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Glenn Phillips, FOUR, a nice cheeky late dab to the third man fence to finish the game. New Zealand win by 7 wickets and it ends 3-2 in favour of India. Was short from Bhuvi and Phillips used the pace on offer to place it in the gap between short third and backward point

Santner (2/2): [On New Zealand's bowling depth] Yeah, I think we're in a great spot in terms of depth at the moment. I guess with the schedule there's been a lot more rotation than probably would be. But it gives guys opportunities, which is nice. Some fringe guys who don't potentially play a lot. And they're showing that they can step up straight away, which is cool as well. So in terms of the depth like you talked about, we're in a good spot. [On Glenn Phillips' consistency] Yeah, I mean to do it every game is pretty special. He does give himself a little bit of time and then he can hit some good areas, play some strong shots. And against a good bowling attack as we've seen. They're a great side. So for him to do it every game and put us in great positions with the bat, like you said at the start, I think the batting's been really good. You know, 200 most games and then obviously a 260 as well. So yeah, and he was a crucial part of that.
